$comment: REQ-STARTUP-142/143: the fonts and the icon set the build bundles, each with its license file, read by tools/notices/notices.mjs. files are the font files the build carries, relative to the repository root; a font's version and copyright notice are read from its own naming table, and its license file must carry that notice. Every font packages/ui/src/fonts.css bundles must be named here, or validation fails because its license file is missing. package names an installed package whose version the entry takes. The three OFL-1.1 texts are the upstream projects' own OFL.txt, line endings normalised: JetBrains Mono and Space Grotesk from their repositories, Manrope from the Google Fonts repository (ofl/manrope). Manrope has no files: REQ-STARTUP-142 names it and no build carries it yet (packages/ui/src/fonts.css; OQ-73).
